newsitem.title: NORWAY: Bullish Oslo Bourse sets another all-time high.
newsitem.headline: Bullish Oslo Bourse sets another all-time high.

text.p: The Norwegian Total index set a new all-time high for the fifth consecutive session on Tuesday following a relatively slow morning.
The index closed at 867.08, up 0.32 percent from Monday as trade picked up in the afternoon. Turnover was a brisk 721 million crowns with blue chip dominating the trade.
Many buyers were in the market but there were some reports of profit-taking.
Industrial conglomerate Norsk Hydro, which has a 20 percent weighting on the Total index, rose 0.81 percent to 311 crowns in 61 million crowns worth of trade.
Food-based conglomerate Orkla was a winner, its A share jumping 3.36 percent to 400 crowns in turnover of 61.6 million crowns.
A broker said the market was still impressed with Orkla's strong eight-months profits presented last week.
"The figures looked very good and analysts returned star-eyed from the presentation," he said.
